data.name: Zomvac
data.detailed_description:
👻 Demo our now

Add to your wishlist now and be among the first to experience the haunted hotel horror of ZOMVAC.
Explore 6 cursed floors, outsmart ghost vacuums, and rescue lost guests in this spooky 2D adventure full of retro charm and dark humor.

🎮 Demo out now
🎯 Full release TBA


About the Game

ZOMVAC is a spooky top-down 2D pixel horror adventure set inside a haunted hotel overrun by brain-sucking vacuums. Explore six cursed floors, each filled with ghostly enemies, hidden collectibles, quirky guests, and sinister secrets waiting to be unraveled.

You’ll play as Evan, Maya as you navigate dark corridors, dodge possessed machines, and rescue guests from mysterious forces. Each floor offers unique puzzles, randomized elements, and miniboss encounters. From the colorful chaos of Floor 2 to the eerie playroom on Floor 4, every section of the hotel brings new horrors and surprises.

Fight for your life, solve spirit vaults, and collect Spirit Shards, Silver Keys, and power-ups to unlock new areas and outcomes. Face down terrifying bosses like the CordCoil Crusher and Upright Overlord, and uncover the truth behind the hotel’s downfall.

Inspired by nostalgic horror games and quirky platformers, ZOMVAC blends dark comedy, spooky pixel art, and replayable chaos into one unforgettable nightmare vacation.

Key Features:

  • 👻 Top-down 2D horror with pixel art and cartoon gore

  • 🏨 Explore 6 haunted hotel floors, each with distinct puzzles and themes

  • 🧹 Avoid ghost vacuums with rising hoses, glowing eyes, and unique attack patterns

  • 🗝️ Collectibles galore – Silver Keys, Spirit Shards, and more

  • 🎮 Multiple game modes – Modern (autosave), Retro (lives), Super Retro (no saves)

  • 💀 Boss fights with minibosses and final-floor nightmares

  • 🎭 Dark humor + jump scares, perfect for E10+ pixel horror fans

  • 🎬 Unlockable endings, cutscenes, and secrets

  • 🏆 Steam Achievements and Easter eggs
